name: Tip Calculator
summary: Split a bill with tip — tip amount, total, and per-person share, locally.
description: Enter the bill, tip percent, and number of people. Get tip amount, grand total, and even splits. Quick presets for common tip rates.

faqs.question: How is the tip calculated?
faqs.answer: Tip = bill × (tip% / 100). Total = bill + tip. Per person divides the total evenly.

faqs.question: Can I split between more than two people?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set People to any whole number ≥ 1.

faqs.question: Is my bill uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
